name: Big Yellow Group Plc
summary: Big Yellow Group Plc is a Real Estate Investment Trust listed on the London Stock Exchange and a member of the FTSE 250. It provides self-storage to domestic and business customers across the UK through two brands. On 31 March 2026, it operated 113 stores: 89 Big Yellow stores, mainly in London and the Southeast, and 24 Armadillo stores across the UK. A further 12 sites are in the development pipeline. The current maximum lettable area of the existing platform is 6.7 million sq ft.
